svg.title: Graphic 10.3 — Course Setup
svg.desc: Top-down obstacle course setup showing line placement, clearance area, and four setup rules. The simple robot icon has been replaced by the approved mini Zumo image with a transparent background. All instructional labels remain live SVG text.
svg.text: GRAPHIC 10.3 — Course Setup
Lesson 10 · §4.4
TOP-DOWN — set this up before you upload anything
intersection
NOT HERE
too much at once
a BORING, STRAIGHT stretch — no green markers, no turns
BLOCK
squarely ON the line, CENTERED
30 cm of CLEAR FLOOR
nothing here. no wall, no chair leg, no other robot.
≥ 30 cm
AVOID_PAST_CM = 20
what the robot
actually drives
the robot detours
to THIS side
why 30, not 20?
the extra 10 cm is
your margin for a
turn that overshoots.
FOUR RULES — get these wrong and you will blame your code
Set up your Lesson 9 course, exactly as before.
Same mat, same tape, same intersections. Change one thing at a time.
Pick a STRAIGHT section, well away from any green marker.
Near an intersection you test three things at once, and
when it fails you will not know which one broke.
Put the obstacle squarely ON the line, centered.
Off-center, it may slip past an edge and never trigger.
Light, tall, flat, wide, heavy — see §4.3.
Leave 30 cm of clear floor on the detour side.
The robot drives 20 cm out there, blind. Give it room to be wrong.
CAUTION: Test on a boring straight line first.
Make it work. THEN get mean — move the block near a
turn, put two in a row, place one while it is driving.
A failure you cannot locate is not a test.
